g.text: Persistent suffix graph — CoW rebuild, log, then CAS-publish
(reads never block; acknowledged ⟹ durable AND visible)
Concurrent reads observe the committed snapshot — no writer lock
Step 1 — durability gate: append Prepare DURABLE, before any visibility
Step 2 — rebuild the candidate off to the side (copy-on-write)
Step 3 — publish: pointer-identity CAS (the linearization point)
